title: Program Terms, Section 4 — Pals Rewards Reward Certificates
content:
**4.1 Status.** The membership status is active or pending downgrade when a **Pals Rewards and Tailwise Plus** reward certificate is issued or reissued, as the membership record shows it.

**4.2 Issue.** Where the tier issues certificates automatically, every time the points balance reaches the tier's points-per-certificate figure, that many points are converted into one certificate worth the tier's certificate value. The certificate is usable for the tier's validity days counted in calendar days from issue, the issue date counting as day 1.

**4.3 Use.** Up to the tier's per-order maximum of certificates may be used on one order. Certificates cannot be used on the tier's excluded categories; an unused remainder is lost unless the tier allows partial use; and they combine with coupons where the tier allows it.

**4.4 Retired clause.** The clause under which a certificate used on an order that is later returned was reissued with a fresh validity, where the tier reissues on return, is **no longer in force**; it has been superseded by the current basis for that reissue.

**4.5 Courtesy reissue.** Where the tier allows a courtesy reissue, an expired, unused certificate may be reissued once as a courtesy. A courtesy reissue of an expired certificate is granted only if it is requested no later than the tier's reissue window days after the certificate's expiry date. The window is counted in calendar days from the last usable day shown on the certificate's issue entry, the day after expiry being day 1; a request on the last day is in time. A courtesy reissue is made only where no reissue entry on the rewards history already refers to the same certificate.

**4.6 Cash value.** Certificates have no cash value and are never refunded.

### Courtesy reissue window — boundary cases (hypothetical dates, 30-day window)

| Last usable day of the certificate | Day 1 of the window | Last day of the window | Request on that last day | Request one day later |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 10 May | 11 May | 9 June | in time | not in time |
| 31 January (non-leap year) | 1 February | 2 March | in time | not in time |

A tier whose reissue window is 0 days grants no courtesy reissue, since no day after expiry falls inside its window.

### Validity count (hypothetical)
A certificate issued on 1 March with a 30-day validity is usable through 30 March: 1 March is day 1 and 30 March is day 30.

### Courtesy reissue of an expired, unused certificate on a tier that allows it

| Membership active or pending downgrade | Requested within the window | No earlier reissue of the same certificate | Courtesy reissue |
|---|---|---|---|
| yes | yes | yes | may be granted, once |
| no | any | any | not granted |
| any | no | any | not granted |
| any | any | no | not granted |

superseded_clauses: A certificate used on an order that is later returned is reissued with a fresh validity where certificate_reissue_on_return is true.
